# Iwons

> An original coding adventure, one keystroke at a time. Practice 500 challenges across 9 chapters and 54 units in JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and Java. Built by Snowi (https://snowi-cambronero.vercel.app/).

Iwons is a browser-only, privacy-preserving coding practice platform. There is no application backend or remote database; all personal progress, submissions, and code remain in the user's browser localStorage.

## Main Navigation & Curricula

- [Home](https://iwons.vercel.app/): Overview of the Iwons platform, methodology, and starting points.
- [The Path](https://iwons.vercel.app/path/): The core curriculum structured into 9 chapters and 54 units.
- [Problems Catalog](https://iwons.vercel.app/problems/): Searchable index of 500 original algorithmic coding exercises.
- [Algorithm Visualizer](https://iwons.vercel.app/visualizer/): Interactive workbench powered by 6 SVG engines visualizing 67 data structures and algorithms.
- [Study Plans](https://iwons.vercel.app/plans/): Curated practice tracks and schedules.
- [About Iwons](https://iwons.vercel.app/about/): Philosophy, honest progress tracking, and runtime architecture.
- [Personal Desk](https://iwons.vercel.app/dashboard/): Local workspace and recent problem history.
- [Progress Tracker](https://iwons.vercel.app/progress/): Chapter completion statistics and learning metrics.
- [Daily Warm-up](https://iwons.vercel.app/warm-up/): Spaced repetition practice queue.
- [Contest Mode](https://iwons.vercel.app/contest/): Timed competitive practice sprints.

## The 9 Chapters of the Iwons Path

- [Chapter 1: Hello, Keys](https://iwons.vercel.app/path/0/): Variables, expressions, conditionals, loop accumulators, and helper functions (30 challenges).
- [Chapter 2: Typebars](https://iwons.vercel.app/path/1/): Adjacent positions, string runs, stable array filtering, and string scanning (50 challenges).
- [Chapter 3: Roller & Platen](https://iwons.vercel.app/path/2/): Frequency counting, key normalization, two-pointer rendezvous, and sliding windows (50 challenges).
- [Chapter 4: Ribbon & Spool](https://iwons.vercel.app/path/3/): Substring matches, prefix sums, binary search variants, and fast/slow pointers (50 challenges).
- [Chapter 5: Line Space Lever](https://iwons.vercel.app/path/4/): Stacks, queues, monotonicity, and recursion foundations (50 challenges).
- [Chapter 6: Carriage Return](https://iwons.vercel.app/path/5/): Linked node traversal, reversals, merge patterns, and node removals (50 challenges).
- [Chapter 7: Shift Lock](https://iwons.vercel.app/path/6/): Binary trees, traversals, binary search trees, and heaps (70 challenges).
- [Chapter 8: Bell & Margin](https://iwons.vercel.app/path/7/): Graph representation, BFS, DFS, and topological sorting (70 challenges).
- [Chapter 9: Escapement](https://iwons.vercel.app/path/8/): Dynamic programming, memoization, interval scheduling, and backtracking (80 challenges).

## Technical Runtimes & Safety

User code executes exclusively inside dedicated Web Workers with termination timeouts. No user code is ever executed on the main thread or sent to any remote server.
JavaScript and TypeScript execute with self-hosted Sucrase and V8 runtimes. Python executes with browser-side WebAssembly via Pyodide. Java mode requires an explicitly configured external runtime endpoint.
